objective: One final evaluation of the validation-locked augmented LSTM configuration on the cleaned test split.
decision_rule: A video is positive when at least one complete rolling mean of K consecutive sequence scores is greater than or equal to theta.
score_generation: Same implementation as validation selection: 20-frame windows, stride 5, EfficientNetB0 features and the epoch-6 augmented LSTM head.
short_clip_policy: Repeat the last frame exactly as in validation selection so all candidate K values remain comparable.
